query:
UPDATE live_sessions
        SET
            current_viewers = $2,
            peak_viewers = GREATEST(peak_viewers, $2),
            total_watch_time_seconds = total_watch_time_seconds + ($2::BIGINT * $3),
            status = CASE
                WHEN $2 > 0 THEN 'live'
                ELSE status
            END,
            updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE livekit_room_name = $1
        RETURNING id                              AS "id: Uuid",
                  peak_viewers                    AS "peak_viewers: i32",
                  total_watch_time_seconds        AS "total_watch_time_seconds: i64"
